_about: Fragment case presentation derivation (List 22 #213) — the presentation annex to #98's case. #98's law is unchanged: the case is a view over #12 progress flags, one slot per dojo in circuit order, holding a Fragment IS the flag existing; there is no fragment item and no stored case state. Everything below is computed at render.

case_view.completion: case-complete is a render state, not a flag — #100's gauntlet reads the same flags for its own gate; no package writes a case-done fact

derived_states.case_complete: all slots lit — the case renders the circuit whole
derived_states.next: the earliest dim slot in a linear circuit (presentation focus, derived); in a loosened-order region (#143), the set of currently reachable dim slots

case_view.region: one case view per region circuit (#143) — Region 1 instanced (8 slots, linear); Regions 2-5 render nothing until their circuits exist (#143 OPEN)

continuity.carried: a physical carried object — #116 wardrobe-adjacent (travels with the Ranger's presentation), #150 kit-adjacent but NOT a kit slot (it displays; it grants nothing)
continuity.show: the case on screen shows exactly the flags the record holds at that story point (#82 conservation applies to props — an episode showing an unearned Fragment is a continuity defect)

open_slots: the case's physical design — materials, form, ornament (owner OPEN, inherited from #98; this grammar deliberately does not narrow it)
loosened-circuit next rendering: set vs path (#143's ordering data decides)
refusals: fragment items or inventory in any form
case upgrades as progression data (a fancier case is a #116 presentation fact)
